scope: Recursively verify theorem-checker proof/source/receipt bindings. External source documents are exact-byte input leaves; their historical governance graphs are not qualification imports. Only the enumerated immutable historical contexts, hostile fixtures, temporary shadow captures and dynamic navigation links are nonqualification metadata. No proof module/evidence exclusions are permitted.
toolchain_resolution: Only the original bound F0 statement and stress audits standard_library_imports entries resolve relative to the pinned compiler root; every hash is checked, including official private/server parts.
